annotations.title: Quote a PDF parse (free, exact price)

description: Free quote for PDF parsing: page count, route (text/scan-OCR) and the exact final price, before any payment. Use the returned quote_id with parse_document (on /mcp or /mcp/docs).
name: quote_parse

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

payment_required.description: true when status is 402: body holds x402 payment terms, not a result. Pay and call again with x_payment

receipt_id.description: set on paid results; free re-fetch via get_receipt

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)

title: Quote a PDF parse (free, exact price)
